evals.prompt: Add a new shared statistical estimator to statgpu. Start with the simplest correct implementation.
evals.expected_output: The workflow treats NumPy, CuPy, and Torch as the default completion contract for a genuinely new shared numerical capability, while allowing CPU-first as an intermediate implementation rather than declaring it complete.
assertions: The plan includes NumPy, CuPy, and Torch closure or an explicit approved narrower contract/deferral.
A CPU-only first step is not labeled COMPLETE.

evals.prompt: Deprecate one constructor parameter without changing numerical dispatch or results.
evals.expected_output: The workflow keeps scope on API compatibility, warnings, clone/get_params/set_params and targeted regressions instead of opening unrelated GPU, inference or CV implementation work.
assertions: The response treats the task as API/deprecation work.
The response does not require new backend implementations merely because the estimator has GPU support.
The response checks omission versus explicit legacy defaults and sklearn-style reconstruction where applicable.

evals.prompt: Expose a new tunable loss x penalty combination in the public penalized-model API.
evals.expected_output: The workflow includes direct fit plus CV path/grid/folds/scoring/selection/final-refit closure by default and does not allow the first implementation to avoid CV simply by omitting the claim.
assertions: Direct fit and CV are both part of the default completion contract.
Any CV deferral is explicit rather than implied by omission.
